scenes.label: Rotating globe
scenes.alt: A city held inside a glass sphere, turning slowly once on its axis: grey towers lit by magenta neon, a bay of pink lights below, and a bright green rim around the globe.

scenes.label: City globe, daylight
scenes.alt: A city inside a glass sphere in daylight: a domed park with blue pools, trees and towers, a marina of white yachts along the bottom, and a bright green rim around the globe.

scenes.label: City globe, dusk
scenes.alt: A city inside a glass sphere after dark: towers lit in warm amber and cyan, a blue-lit dome and fountains, a marina of yachts below, and a bright green rim around the globe.

scenes.label: City globe, night
scenes.alt: The city at night seen from above inside a glass sphere: dark towers, a cyan-lit plaza, a gold-lit dome, a bay of pink lights below, and a bright green rim around the globe.

scenes.label: Spiral city
scenes.alt: A spiralling city inside a glass sphere: a tall central tower wrapped by a gold spiral ramp, glass domes and gardens, a bay of pink lights below, and a bright green rim around the globe.

scenes.label: Code red
scenes.alt: The city under red alert light: the globe floods red and a laser sweeps the city grid.

scenes.label: Storm front
scenes.alt: A bank of cloud rolling over the city inside the glass sphere, swallowing the towers, and rolling away again.

scenes.label: Dive into the city
scenes.alt: The camera diving through the glass sphere into the city, down between the towers and past red neon arches, and back out to the wide view.

scenes.label: Edge of the city
scenes.alt: The camera running out to the edge of the city, down between the towers to street level, and back out to the wide view of the globe.

scenes.label: Cinematic zoom
scenes.alt: A cinematic zoom out of the orb, the camera pulling back from the city until the whole globe stands in space again.

scenes.label: Sea level
scenes.alt: The camera descending to street level inside the glass sphere, looking up between the towers of the city.

scenes.label: Scan sequence
scenes.alt: The city inside the globe scanned in red: a wireframe of the towers with a bright red laser sweeping across it, the globe going dark and coming back blue.

scenes.label: Globe scan
scenes.alt: A city inside a glass sphere with a bright cyan wave sweeping through the sphere and across the city, and the city settling back.

scenes.label: Red team scan
scenes.alt: The city under red alert light with a red laser sweeping the grid and green system readouts around it.

scenes.label: Nightfall, garden city
scenes.alt: The daylight city inside the glass sphere going into night: the sky behind the glass darkens through sunset, and the lights of the towers, the dome and the marina come on one by one.

scenes.label: Nightfall, grey city
scenes.alt: The grey city inside the glass sphere going into night as the camera drifts in: the sky turns violet and then dark, and the towers light up amber and cyan around glowing blue pools.
